user.title: Adaptive Hydraulic Pump Optimizer
user.description: Select the entities that provide each required signal.

settings.title: Algorithm settings
settings.description: Configure the optimizer algorithm parameters. Defaults work for most installations.

data.min_compressor_frequency_hz: Minimum compressor frequency (Hz) — ignore samples below this
data.min_charge_pump_speed_percent: Minimum charge pump speed (%) — clamp output and learning to this floor
data.min_speed_step_percent: Minimum charge pump speed step (%) — suppress changes smaller than this threshold
data.confidence_threshold: Confidence threshold to switch to active optimization (0–1)
data.confidence_max_spread_error_std: Maximum spread-error standard deviation for full stability score (K)
data.settling_time_minutes: Settling time after a setpoint change (minutes)

init.title: Edit entity mapping
init.description: Update the entities mapped to each signal. Changes take effect after saving.

data.min_compressor_frequency_hz: Minimum compressor frequency (Hz) — ignore samples below this
data.min_charge_pump_speed_percent: Minimum charge pump speed (%) — clamp output and learning to this floor
data.min_speed_step_percent: Minimum charge pump speed step (%) — suppress changes smaller than this threshold
data.confidence_threshold: Confidence threshold to switch to active optimization (0–1)
data.confidence_max_spread_error_std: Maximum spread-error standard deviation for full stability score (K)
data.settling_time_minutes: Settling time after a setpoint change (minutes)

reset_confidence.name: AHPO: Reset confidence
reset_confidence.description: Resets the confidence score of every cell to zero (keeps the learned data).

set_phase_override.name: AHPO: Set phase override
set_phase_override.description: Force Phase A (passive) or Phase B (active) globally, or return to automatic per-cell confidence-based switching.

export_characteristic_map.name: AHPO: Export characteristic map
export_characteristic_map.description: Writes the current characteristic map to a JSON file.
